limitations: A training-to-test distribution difference is not proof of temporal concept drift or causal degradation.
The test partition may differ in engine lifecycle composition and observation length.
Rows from the same engine are not independent observations; row-level KS p-values can overstate evidence.
This is a screening experiment. A deployment system should also monitor engine-level summaries and use time-aware validation and operational feedback.
The reassessment rule is a predefined screening rule, not a learned optimal maintenance policy.
No test RUL labels were used to select thresholds or policies.
